ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Forming shadows in light? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Forming shadows in light.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Forming shadows in light.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Forming shadows in light.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Forming shadows in light.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Recording weather? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Recording weather.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Recording weather.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Recording weather.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Recording weather.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

15. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Energy: Light its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Forming shadows in light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Precautions when using and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain School environment environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping Safe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
